verdict.rationale: Ente Auth has its own export: encrypted exports whose JSON structure, versioning and key derivation are publicly documented, an official CLI that can decrypt them, and a named "plaintext export format". A community user, however, reports you can't easily export into another app's format (e.g. Bitwarden/Aegis), so leaving still takes a conversion step rather than a one-click hand-off. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs for a one-tap plaintext/otpauth export from the app, direct export into other authenticators' formats, independent hands-on reports of migrating out of Ente.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
